config.quickStartMenu.description: Customize the entries shown in the FS Quick Start menu. Use the "FS Quick Start: Add/Edit/Remove/Move/Reset menu entry" commands (also reachable from the gear icon in the menu itself) to manage this list without editing JSON. Leave empty to use the built-in default menu. When set, this list completely replaces the default entries: each entry needs a `label` and a `command` id (any built-in or contributed VS Code command), and may optionally include a `description`, an `icon` (a codicon name, e.g. `server-process`), and `args` (a list of arguments passed to the command).
config.quickStartMenu.items.args: Optional list of arguments passed to the command when this entry is selected.
config.quickStartMenu.items.command: Command id executed when this entry is selected.
config.quickStartMenu.items.description: Optional secondary text shown next to the label.
config.quickStartMenu.items.label: Text shown for this menu entry.
